resources.string: Cycles elapsed = beat rate (Hz) × elapsed time (s), including any partial cycle. Time per cycle (ms) = 1,000 ÷ beat rate (Hz).

This teaching model simulates one motile cilium in the ciliated epithelium of a human uterine tube, beating at a constant rate. The inputs are synthetic examples, not medical measurements or reference ranges. The model does not predict egg-cell (ovum) velocity, ovulation, conception, pregnancy, or individual fertility.
